'''Corte Voss''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who captained the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Titan's Mercy]]'' and its crew of five, including the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Kef (smuggler)|Kef]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Voss made a poor deal with the [[Gorensla/Legends|Gorensla]], which lost her a large sum of money. She later attempted to cheat the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Thamoss]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="LoNH" />
